name: Sora o Miagete Omou Koto
original_name: そらをみあげて想うこと
source:
In 2005 an artificial object flew into the Earth orbit. At the same time people with different supernatural powers started to appear on the planet. A research team was sent to the object and exploded together with the object.
In 2015 main character with the power of "possibility expansion" enrolls to a private school on a solitary island. This power helps to create the 3rd option when facing a fork. He communicates with teachers and students possessing different abilities without knowing that it's going to draw him closer to revealing the mystery of the space cube artificial object...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
2005年，一件人造物体进入地球轨道。与此同时，拥有不同超自然能力的人开始出现在地球上。一个研究小组被派去调查那件物体，却与它一同爆炸。
2015年，拥有“可能性扩张”能力的主人公进入一座孤岛上的私立学校。面对分岔路口时，这种能力能够创造第三种选择。他与拥有不同能力的教师和学生交流，却不知道自己正因此逐渐接近揭开太空立方体人造物的谜团……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
